method: Each numeric table value (CT HU; MRI PD, T1, T2, T2* at 1.5 T) was looked up in PubMed abstracts, open PMC full-text paragraphs and the Consensus abstract index. 'verified' = the number (mean / median / range) is printed in an abstract or full-text paragraph that was read; the viewer uses the statistic named in 'statistic'. Table cells of the key papers (Gold 2004, Stanisz 2005, Bottomley 1984, de Bazelaire 1.5 T, Lamba 2014, IT'IS database reference PDFs) could not be opened (no egress to the publishers/PMC/IT'IS pages from the sandbox; the full-text tool drops tables), so those values stay unverified.
definitions: verified = number (or its mean/median/range) read in an accessible PubMed abstract or open full-text prose this session; derived = computed from verified numbers; secondary_checked = seen only in a secondary compilation / search excerpt; assumption = modelling choice; recalled_unverified = value kept from Q226, NOT re-read
